text_post: Having recently gone through 4 months (cumulative) of being unemployed over the past 2 years, I'll offer my perspective. - Having a lot of free time on your hands is great. - Having time on your hands with no motivation to use it, fucking sucks. Regarding lack of work hours; If it's help/advice you're looking for, it would be helpful if you tell us what kind of work you do and what kinds of skills/education you have.   We aren't Monster.com but I'll bet some of us might be able to give you a pointer or two if you think you want it. Regarding lack of motivation;  It's been said that men need that "carrot on a stick" (the potential to get laid) to motivate them into being productive.   If you've become disillusioned because women and DSR are too much of a pain in the ass for you (whether it be due to LS, incel, taking the "red pill", etc.) then yeah; you're probably gonna feel like shit and you won't want to do anything but sleep and watch paint dry.   Depending on how mentally strong you are, it CAN get better but it helps if you have something to focus on.   I use the gym, my friends and team-based video games.   Maybe there's something that you enjoy that can give a kick in the pants to get you back on track.
